title: [Monaco] Build Monaco 0.57 from a pinned npm package instead of vendoring it

proposed_comments.title: Keep input enumeration compatible with Node 20.11
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep input enumeration compatible with the advertised Node 20 prerequisite

**Severity:** `medium`

`Dirent.parentPath` was added in Node 20.12, but the package's `>=20` engine requirement and the CI/developer setup checks also accept earlier Node 20 releases. With Node 20.11.1, dependency installation succeeds, then this call throws `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE` while hashing the source directory, preventing the Monaco bundle and its consuming projects from building. Please fall back to the older `Dirent.path` property so those accepted runtimes work while newer runtimes continue using `parentPath`.

```suggestion
        .map((entry) => path.relative(root, path.join(entry.parentPath ?? entry.path, entry.name)));
```

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream fails after successful npm ci on authentic Node 20.11.1; the byte-verified one-line patch builds and passes focused behavior/language checks on 20.11.1 and 26.13.0.
